registered_at: 2026-10-29 prior to openframe run1; first validate per-part contact source
scope: Single bounded G2 open-frame actor comparison. Same 20x15 cm footprint, sparse visible section. Not arbitrary shape coverage or independent dynamic opponent.

launch.entry_r0: demo.launch.py (same arguments as the existing validator's local_pursuit path, g1_follow_enabled unset=false)
launch.speed_profile_note: max 1.0 m/s, min 0.20, accel 1.0 = exploratory except the cap. G1 effective cap is min(1.0, profile) = 1.0 in both profiles; R0 receives the same 1.0 m/s command cap.
launch.temporary_traffic_light_trigger: existing provisional RGB red->green detector is used only as this low-speed control test trigger; the official 10/6 lights-out start is a separate unresolved redesign

vehicle_and_sensor_unchanged: B0183+C1+LSM6DSOX, 20x15 cm, about 2 kg, motor shaft 28 counts x 15:1, 65 mm wheel, 0.135 m wheelbase, C1 plane 0.095 m / front 0.06 m / rear 60 deg mask

actor.visible_section: C1 z=.095 m intersects four 20x20 mm posts only; .20x.15 base/roof stay below/above beam. Full projected footprint remains .20x.15; rays can pass between posts.
actor.physics: static model moved by evaluator set_pose (teleport); collision geometry and contact sensor follow the commanded pose (g1b_contact_probe_v1). Infinite-mass blocker, not a vehicle dynamics model.
actor.start_center_gap_note: target centre 1.2 m ahead of ego centre along the centerline (synthetic sequence layout)

seed_note: Gazebo has no injected noise here; a seed fixes a deterministic actor start offset along the centerline so that scan/command phase differs between repetitions.
schedule_anchor: sim time at which the evaluator first observes applied=green on /sim/traffic_light/state (evaluator only; the controller detects green from its own camera)

cases.name: g2_openframe_stopped_right
cases.expected: Open-frame stationary actor at right road edge, bypass left, return to centre. Contact/footprint evaluated against full base plate; not inferred from visible posts.

straight_section_check: actor final centre must stay at least 1.0 m before the first corner (centerline s=5.3 m after the start line)

acceptance.minimum_body_gap_basis: G1-a pre-registered minimum body gap (config/tests/g1_follow_v1.json); applied to BOTH the sampled gap and the conservative swept lower bound
acceptance.swept_note: lower bound assumes rigid planar motion with monotonic yaw between ego pose samples and path curvature <= tan(0.37)/0.135 = 2.9 /m
acceptance.outside_road_basis: existing conservative 20x15 cm body-outside-SDF-road criterion; the 10/6 two-wheel grass relaxation memo is not adopted

stopped_center.basis: HOLD at G1 swept clearance <= 0.20 m (+ about 0.06-0.13 m padding) predicts a 0.2-0.45 m body gap (synthetic 0.405 m). 0.70 m is half of the 1.40 m initial gap: it separates an approach-and-hold from a stall near the start. 3.0 s of continuous zero speed within a 10 s window.

slow_lead.basis: lead travels 4.2 m; following must not degenerate into a permanent stall. 2.5 s reuses the G1-a restart limit. Final gap must be below the 1.40 m start gap.

stop_restart.basis: G1-a restart limit 2.5 s; lead travels 2.1 m after restart

acceptance.stationary_definition: model ground speed < 0.01 m/s, /drive/safe speed == 0 and (G1) behavior HOLD; R0 has no behavior field

harness.basis: G0 command interval limit; 0.035 m = about 0.1 s of 0.35 m/s lag. A harness failure invalidates the run instead of counting as a controller result.

acceptance.threshold_status: pre-registered before execution; not measured real vehicle guarantees. Do not relax after results; a change needs a new config version and a rerun.

g2.registered_note: v2 = run1 registered gates + window split + negative-tested core (g2_eval_core.py). Applied to run1 only as a labelled post-hoc audit, never as run1 registered criteria.
g2.target_passed: ego body rear corner passes the target body front corner along the centerline (s), before window end
g2.windows: drive window = [green, case_window end]; pass/return/hold judged only there. STOP window = (window end, stop trace end] gated separately (lateral/heading within the centre tolerance). Contact/surface/command cap use green..stop end.
g2.max_sample_interval_basis: current g1d evaluator ego pose coverage maximum_allowed_interval_s (report.evaluation.coverage.ego)
g2.bypass_side_rule: ego lateral sign at the first pass sample must be opposite to the target offset sign (+left)
g2.trace_header_basis: same launch/defaults as run1 (registered G2 trial); any drift fails instead of being reported only
g2.static_target_basis: representative median target pose is valid only for this fixed-target case; actor pose error <= acceptance.harness.actor_static_error_max_m
g2.returned_basis: truth-only check after the pass: G2 own centred state uses 25 mm/0.08 rad on observed walls; the evaluation allows 50 mm/0.10 rad for wall-vs-centerline geometry differences
g2.off_road_basis: official two-wheel grass allowance; any/center/full contact-patch interpretations all reported, all must stay <= 2 wheels with zero 3+ wheel events; wheel-centre-only results are not used as contact-patch evidence. Patches use MCU target steering (planned geometry), not measured wheel steering
g2.command_cap_scope: /drive and /drive/safe trace samples and every replayed decision output
g2.body_gap_policy: minimum body gap is reported only; the old 150 mm G1 line is not a G2 gate (completion-first, ADR 0027)
g2.stop_and_shutdown: existing explicit software_stop, dense pose stop evidence, MCU latch, clean shutdown
g2.decision_replay: schema4 g2_decisions.jsonl replays every call identically
g2.sensor_only: controller/safety/actuation subscriptions sensor-only; /drive only from the controller node and /drive/safe only from lidar_safety; actor pose read only by the evaluator

g2_openframe_stopped_right.basis: HOLD at G1 swept clearance <= 0.20 m (+ about 0.06-0.13 m padding) predicts a 0.2-0.45 m body gap (synthetic 0.405 m). 0.70 m is half of the 1.40 m initial gap: it separates an approach-and-hold from a stall near the start. 3.0 s of continuous zero speed within a 10 s window.
